summary:
Plan of w206 in plan.md. None of the 7 accepted scenarios (work-queue r34-r39) is red: all pass at fb9cc6d3.
Decided: list --json drops the request's turn (finding 2; r35's 'nothing besides'). A malformed raised.jsonl line is refused under r7, naming the file and line, with no traceback (finding 3, D1/D2). The r36 branch stays the checkout's. Status and bare show stay: no Retires section.

Open: finding 1 (write_proposals in supervise_change.py, triaged fix now) is a supervision behaviour that no accepted line of w206 covers. r142 and r148 do not say what becomes of a proposal held for another capability, so the plan asks.
questions: Finding 1 of branch review 2 (fix now): scripts/supervise_change.py write_proposals rewrites the lists of a capability-proposal held for another capability that a redraft integrate round's change list names. w206 accepts only work-queue r34-r39, and supervision r142 and r148 do not say what becomes of that other proposal. Reading A: leave it out of w206 and give it its own work-item under supervision, after a line settles it; until then the narrator still sees the other proposal's adds and removes overwritten by the round's ids. Reading B: fix it in w206 by merging (union) the round's ids into the other proposal's lists, as the findings propose; the narrator sees that proposal keep its applied ids, with the round's ids added. Reading C: fix it in w206 by leaving the other proposal untouched; the narrator sees its lists unchanged and the round's ids for that capability written nowhere. Under B or C the file set gains scripts/supervise_change.py and tests/scripts/test_supervise_change.py.
